locations_board_window.name: locations_board_window
locations_board_window.value: "locations"."board_ends_at" is null OR ("locations"."board_starts_at" is not null AND "locations"."board_ends_at" > "locations"."board_starts_at")

sessions_published_timed.name: sessions_published_timed
sessions_published_timed.value: "sessions"."status" = 'draft' OR ("sessions"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."ends_at" IS NOT NULL)

level_events_live_unique.name: level_events_live_unique
level_events_live_unique.where: "level_events"."voided_at" is null and "level_events"."user_id" is not null

quests_level_window_needs_class.name: quests_level_window_needs_class
quests_level_window_needs_class.value: "quests"."class" is not null or ("quests"."min_level" is null and "quests"."max_level" is null)
